parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app. Each goal has a short home activity: say the words aloud together, and let your child guess first.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط قصير في البيت. قولوا الكلمات بصوت عالي مع بعض، وسيبوا طفلك يتوقع الأول.

steps.title: A story opener
steps.prompt: Which one is a story opener?
steps.explanation: Long ago is a story opener, like Once upon a time.
steps.shortExplanation: Long ago is a story opener, like Once upon a time.

source.answerKeyText: Any story opener, e.g. Once upon a time

steps.title: The thirsty one
steps.prompt: Who drank all the water in the land?
steps.hint: He was a very thirsty frog.
steps.explanation: Tiddalik the frog drank all the water in the land.
steps.shortExplanation: Tiddalik the frog drank all the water in the land.

steps.title: Join with and
steps.prompt: The lion is big. The lion is proud. Which one joins them?

options.label: The lion is big and proud.
The lion and big is proud.
The lion is big. and proud.

steps.hint: And goes between big and proud.
steps.explanation: The lion is big and proud. And joins the two ideas.
steps.shortExplanation: The lion is big and proud. And joins the two ideas.

source.answerKeyText: The lion is big and proud.

steps.title: Is there a verb?
steps.prompt: The water everywhere. Does this sentence have a verb?
steps.hint: What did the water do? Nothing is said.
steps.explanation: There is no doing word, so The water everywhere has no verb.
steps.shortExplanation: There is no doing word, so The water everywhere has no verb.

steps.title: The bossy verb
steps.prompt: Wash your hands before lunch. Which word is the bossy verb?
steps.hint: Which word tells you what to do?
steps.explanation: Wash tells you what to do, so it is the bossy verb.
steps.shortExplanation: Wash tells you what to do, so it is the bossy verb.

steps.title: a or an?
steps.prompt: Do we say a or an?
steps.hint: Which one starts with a vowel sound?
steps.explanation: We say an egg and a cake. Egg starts with a vowel sound.
steps.shortExplanation: We say an egg and a cake. Egg starts with a vowel sound.

steps.title: The last step
steps.prompt: Which time word can start the last step?
steps.hint: Which word means at the very end?
steps.explanation: Finally starts the last step of instructions.
steps.shortExplanation: Finally starts the last step of instructions.

steps.title: Rhymes with pool
steps.explanation: Pool and school both end with ool, so they rhyme.
steps.shortExplanation: Pool and school both end with ool, so they rhyme.

steps.title: Yesterday it…
steps.explanation: Yesterday it snowed. Ed tells us it already happened.
steps.shortExplanation: Yesterday it snowed. Ed tells us it already happened.

steps.title: Drip and drop
steps.prompt: Do drip and drop rhyme, or start the same?
steps.hint: Listen to the start: dr, dr.
steps.explanation: Drip and drop both start with dr, but they end differently.
steps.shortExplanation: Drip and drop both start with dr, but they end differently.

goalActivities.text: Start a bedtime story with a new opener each night: Long ago… One day… There once was…
goalActivities.textAr: ابدأ حدوتة النوم بجملة بداية جديدة كل ليلة: Long ago… و One day… و There once was…
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.
